brief.text: A calm recap of the boat trip, 30 seconds, ending when the camp is empty.

idea: A quiet camp wakes up, the group leaves on the boat, and the camp is left empty.

structure.why: The trip starts and ends in the same place, so opening on the empty camp and leaving it empty again makes the trip feel like a small story with a start and an end.

beats.name: Empty camp
beats.intent: set the calm and make the viewer curious

shots.purpose: open on the empty camp so the viewer wonders who comes
shots.why: A short, still opening shot sets the calm and promises that something will change.

moment.hint: the first person walks into the frame

shots.why: The frame settles first and the people walk in, so the viewer sees the change.

shots.purpose: the boat heads for the tunnel
shots.why: Three short pieces of the same approach, each closer, build speed before the tunnel.
Cutting on the wave of the hand carries the eye from the tunnel to the people.
We cut after the last person left, so the frame ends empty like it began.

notes: Owner note followed: end on the empty camp.
